body:
From MMR-34 (accepted): `GeneratedCampaignInitializer` (src/MNBL.ProceduralWorld/Campaign) builds the startup and is verified offline on the size-129 world (`tools/Test-SpawnPolicy.ps1`, 18/18). The startup covers starts for all creation cultures, hideouts, the land bandit clans as aliases, the retirement retreat, spawn anchors and the runtime plan. **It is not called by world generation yet.** Wiring it in is yours.
- Its `Documents` (Settlements: hideouts and retreat; Factions: bandit clans; SPCultures: all 7 creation cultures' start points) and `DeclaredKeys` join the world's registration. The MMR-30 plan accepts them (check 15).
- `Plan` goes to `GeneratedStartupBehavior` through `IGeneratedWorld.StartupPlan`, with `SuppliesStartup = true`. The package must record `adapter.dataset.suppliesStartup` (and `fixturePrefabs` if any entity comes from a prefab), so a load restores both. Run 35880 crashed on load without the prefabs.
- `StartupException.Codes` / `.Retryable` are the bounded quality rejection (`startup.json quality.codes`); see the MMR-44 comment.
- In game, the fixture world shares only the record builders and rules (`BanditClanRecord`, `RetreatRecord`, `StartCultureRecord`, `BanditHome`, `NearestTownCulture`). The initializer's own placement of hideouts, retreat and starts has never been registered in game.
